title: Zscaler technology partner guides: which subject holds which partner guides (split by partner name, not strictly by product)

steps.label: Which partner guides cover ZIA?
steps.text: [[shared.technology-partners.zia]] (partners A–K). Splunk, Sumo Logic, Okta, PingOne, Panther, Plixer and Sekoia are in [[shared.technology-partners.zpa]]; Salesforce, ServiceNow, Slack and SharePoint in [[shared.technology-partners.other]].

steps.label: Which partner guides cover ZPA?
steps.text: [[shared.technology-partners.zpa]] (partners L–Z). CrowdStrike, QRadar, Arctic Wolf, IBM Verify, CyberArk and ForgeRock are in [[shared.technology-partners.zia]]; ZPA-only SAP and Autopilot in [[shared.technology-partners.other]].
